purpose: Feature film continuity specification extending Medium Film Continuity V2 to 1000-3000 scenes with world state, theme, and legacy callback dimensions.

character_arc.definition: Ensemble character DNA stable across 1000-3000 scenes with multi-generation cast rotation.

location_arc.definition: Location geometry and transformation registry across century-scale narrative blocks.

lighting_arc.definition: Lighting DNA palettes with era-variant catalog across feature-length timeline.

relationship_arc.definition: Primary and secondary relationship stages within expanded network evolution.

timeline_arc.definition: Multi-decade timeline markers with long-range dependencies minimum gap 120 scenes.

memory_callback_arc.definition: Memory callback seeds and resolutions across extended foreshadow-payoff spans.

subplot_arc.definition: Multiple independent subplot threads interleaving without breaking primary timeline.

parallel_arc.definition: Three or more parallel narrative tracks with documented interleave intervals.

multi_callback_arc.definition: Multi-layer callback structure with 3-5 independent tiers.

relationship_network.definition: Relationship network nodes and edges evolve through multi-act stage progression.

world_arc.definition: World state stages and location transformations across feature narrative span.

world_state_arc.definition: Macro world-state evolution (political, cultural, environmental) tracked per act block.

theme_arc.definition: Thematic through-line progression with act-level theme beats and symbolic recurrence.

legacy_callback_arc.definition: Cross-generational and cross-era callback chains linking ancestral anchors to present payoff.
